tasks.InitialDownload: Calculate the time to download 40% of the file at 2 GB/minute.
tasks.RestartDueToWindowsUpdate: Account for the 20-minute restart due to Windows update installation.
tasks.ResumingDownload: Calculate the remaining 60% of the file after resuming from the beginning with a speed of 2 GB/minute.
tasks.TotalTimeCalculation: Sum up all the times calculated in previous tasks to get the total time.
